title: 第23章 五年第24章 又见彭左
slug: 从部落开始我有一本山海经
content_zh:
时间荏苒岁月穿梭，自秦氏部落在白峡安居已经过了五年时间，白峡江没有了九铁玄鳇称霸，江面畅通无阻，再也没有了阻碍，五年间秦皓等人每日不间断的练习，没有了酒匠老人的指点，众人开始尝试两两对抗，习惯运用自己身体的野性本能，熟练掌握凌霄破日录中的各种外功招式。
在这五年期间，利用所收集到的精血，秦皓通过合成以后，秦氏部落陆陆续续的多出一个个血纹战士，在山海经的异兽精血普遍强悍的实力下，秦氏部落终于有一批又一批实力强劲的新生力量。
为了磨练自身和寻找精血，秦皓跟族人们说了自己有可以提纯精血的能力，成为了血纹战士的族人，精神力也大大提高。
秦皓让所有血纹战士学会了收集精血的图纹，大大提高收集精血的效率。
四人一组，开始了不间断的恶魔林历练，秦氏部落的战士经历了五年时间与血兽的厮杀，逐渐掌握了属于自己的风格，一招毙命！
在相当于半禁区的恶魔林，任何多余的消耗都是增加死亡的风险，所以秦氏部落的战士必须学会节省自己的气血，用最少的气血和杀意解决敌人。
释放杀意，一招毙命，收集精血一气呵成。
林中，此时正上演着一场人兽争斗，周围三个穿着兽皮衣袍的少年少女围成圈纷纷蹲在树稍上，多年的配合让他们潜意识的围成三角形。
“加油！
族长！”
“哈哈，快让我们看看族长的厉害！”
“阿皓哥，快用你的新能力给大家开开眼呗，哈哈！”
秦皓无奈摇摇头，这帮货就喜欢看热闹。
自己今年与比自己小一岁的秦夏风，和他的小妹秦秋雨，还有就是当年与那十六一起逃回来的秦熊之辛一队进行历练，相互配合。
秦夏风秦秋雨兄妹目前都为贰纹战士，外貌秀丽，二人都高高扎起长发，身材匀称，眉目之间极其相似。
平时性格跳脱，兄妹俩常常会生出奇怪的想法让秦皓哭笑不得。
秦熊之辛倒是上秦皓省心不少，这个在部落中，除了秦邬童以外，身材最为壮实的一个，不同于秦邬童的魁梧强壮，秦熊之辛此时身高两米五六，膀宽腰圆虎背熊腰，可以将秦皓三人完全藏在身后，虽然也是贰纹战士，但是那惊人的握力可将树桩轻松捏碎，远远看去犹如一头熊形血兽，让人胆寒。
此时的秦皓已经十七岁了，身高两米左右，身形挺拔修长，身上隆起的肌肉看起来十分健壮，一头过肩的黑色长发披散在背后，神情自信的面对着对面的三只狼形血兽。
断月轻灵狼，庚级血兽，速度极快，善群攻，此时正狰狞的围着秦皓，等待时机。
秦皓看着眼前的三只庚级血兽，心中平静，自己在这五年期间已经刻纹了第二个图腾，进度始终不算快，毕竟自己的九种图腾合成所需材料太多了，第二个图腾的刻纹药剂也是之前使用九铁玄鳇的精血才成功合成。

部落目前战力巅峰的秦邬童几人已经是叁纹战士，自己虽然不如他们，但是图腾给自己带来的特殊能力使得自身战力也是极为恐怖。
此时断月轻灵狼身影如飞，顷刻间就将秦皓秦皓为核心团团围住，秦皓并不慌张，经过五年千锤百炼的厮杀与战斗，身体本能的告诉秦皓后背的危险，转身躲过了身后那只得攻击，随即血纹显现，双掌立在身侧，身上黑光亮起，正是杀意释放。
双掌处嗡嗡声作响，初如蚊声，到后来声音逐渐变大，犹如钟声，双掌轻轻从断月轻灵狼身躯上拂过。
“寂灭环纹！”
“嗡”
一阵低鸣声响起，像是蜂群飞过，只见那断月轻灵狼瞬间毛发竖立，七窍流血。
见同伴倒地，另外两只断月轻灵狼一时竟不敢上前，向后连退几步，至此秦皓也不犹豫，大步流星奔向其中一只，左手凌空劈去，右拳迅捷之极向前，左手的振动使得它浑身颤抖，浑身麻痹且不能动，右拳凝聚杀意黑光，嘭的一声响，只听得噗嗤的一声，瞬间洞穿血兽头颅，身体缓缓瘫倒。
最后一只断月轻灵狼不知是否被血腥的场面激发了自身血性，连连嘶吼朝秦皓冲了上来，不过当它冲过来时，秦皓也同时高高跃起，一个鞭腿扫向断月轻灵狼，在踢中瞬间，秦皓感觉好像踢中什么柔软的东西，心中暗道果然庚级血兽都有自己的防御能力。
断月轻灵狼虽然没有坚硬的外壳，但是毛发光滑，身体柔软，很好的就将受到的攻击化解解力。
断月轻灵狼张开大嘴奔向秦皓脖颈，猛地加速，极快的速度让身形在秦皓的视线中变得模糊，秦皓只感觉面前腥臭之气传来，随即双手向前一顶，掌心牢牢顶住冲过来的断月轻灵狼的下颚，身下脚尖前踢，杀意的加持下，秦皓轻而易举的穿透了断月轻灵狼的防御。
噗！
content_en:
Time flies and the years pass. It has been five years since the Qin tribe settled in Baixia. The Baixia River no longer has the Jiutie Xuanyu to dominate. The river is unobstructed and there are no obstacles anymore. In the past five years, Qin Hao and others have practiced uninterrupted every day. Without the guidance of the old winemaker, everyone began to try to fight in pairs. They got used to using their own body's wild instincts and mastered various external skills in Ling Xiao's daily record.
During these five years, Qin Hao used the collected essence and blood to synthesize, and the Qin tribe gradually produced more blood-marked warriors. With the generally powerful strength of the essence and blood of the alien beasts in the Book of Mountains and Seas, the Qin tribe finally had batches of powerful new forces.
In order to hone himself and find blood essence, Qin Hao told his clansmen that he had the ability to purify blood essence, and became a clansman of the Blood Pattern Warrior, and his mental power was greatly improved.
Qin Hao taught all blood pattern warriors the patterns for collecting blood essence, which greatly improved the efficiency of collecting blood essence.
A group of four people began their non-stop training in the Demon Forest. After five years of fighting with blood beasts, the warriors of the Qin tribe gradually mastered their own style and killed with one move!
In the Demon Forest, which is equivalent to a semi-forbidden zone, any excess consumption will increase the risk of death, so the warriors of the Qin tribe must learn to save their own energy and blood, and use the least amount of energy and blood to kill the enemy.
Release the murderous intention, kill with one move, and collect blood essence in one go.
In the forest, a battle between man and beast was taking place at this time. Three boys and girls wearing animal skin robes formed a circle and squatted on the tree. Years of cooperation made them subconsciously form a triangle.
“Come on!
Patriarch! "
"Haha, let's see how powerful the clan leader is!"
"Brother Ah Hao, use your new ability to open everyone's eyes, haha!"
Qin Hao shook his head helplessly, these guys just like to watch the fun.
This year, I have been practicing with Qin Xiafeng, who is one year younger than me, his little sister Qin Qiuyu, and Qin Xiong Zhixin, who escaped with Na Shiliu back then, and cooperated with each other.
Brother and sister Qin Xiafeng, Qin Qiuyu are both currently warriors with two lines. They are beautiful in appearance. They both have long hair tied up high and have well-proportioned figures. Their eyebrows are very similar.
Usually out of character, the brother and sister often come up with strange ideas that make Qin Hao laugh or cry.
Qin Xiong Zhixin was more worry-free than Qin Hao. Apart from Qin Wutong, he was the strongest one in the tribe. Unlike Qin Wutong, Qin Xiongzhixin was 2.56 meters tall at this time.
At this time, Qin Hao was already seventeen years old. He was about two meters tall, with a tall and slender figure. The bulging muscles on his body looked very strong. His long black hair that reached over his shoulders was spread behind his back. He faced the three wolf-shaped blood beasts opposite him with a confident expression.
The Broken Moon Light Wolf, a Geng-level blood beast, extremely fast and good at attacking in groups, was ferociously surrounding Qin Hao, waiting for the opportunity.
Qin Hao looked at the three Geng-level blood beasts in front of him and felt calm. He had carved the second totem in the past five years, and the progress was not very fast. After all, he needed too many materials to synthesize the nine totems. The engraving potion for the second totem was also successfully synthesized using the essence and blood of the Jiutie Xuanyu.
Qin Wutong, who is currently at the peak of the tribe's combat power, is already a three-marked warrior. Although he is not as good as them, the special abilities brought to him by the totem make his own combat power extremely terrifying.
At this time, the silhouette of the Broken Moon Light Wolf was like flying, and it immediately surrounded Qin Hao with Qin Hao as its core. Qin Hao did not panic. After five years of hard fighting and fighting, his body instinctively told Qin Hao of the danger on his back. He turned around to avoid the attack behind him, and then blood lines appeared, and he stood with his palms on his side., the black light on his body lit up, it was the release of murderous intent.
There was a buzzing sound in his palms, which was like the sound of mosquitoes at first, but then gradually became louder, like the sound of bells, as his palms gently brushed against the body of the Broken Moon Qingling Wolf.
"Nirvana Ring Pattern!"
"Buzz"
There was a low humming sound, like a swarm of bees flying by, and the fur of the Moon-breaking Spirit Wolf instantly stood on end, and blood flowed from its seven orifices.
Seeing his companion fall to the ground, the other two Moon-breaking Spirit Wolves did not dare to step forward and took a few steps back. At this point, Qin Hao did not hesitate and ran towards one of them. He struck with his left hand in the air and moved his right fist forward very quickly. The vibration of his left hand made it tremble all over, making it paralyzed and unable to move. The right fist condensed the black light of murderous intent. With a bang and a pop, it instantly penetrated the blood beast's head, and its body slowly collapsed.
The last Moon-Breaking Light Wolf didn't know if it was inspired by the bloody scene. It roared and rushed towards Qin Hao. However, when it rushed over, Qin Hao also jumped high at the same time and swept his whip leg towards the Moon-Breaking Light Wolf. At the moment of the kick, Qin Hao felt as if he had hit something soft. He secretly thought that Geng-level blood beasts had their own defense capabilities.
Although the Broken Moon Light Wolf does not have a hard shell, its hair is smooth and its body is soft, which makes it very capable of neutralizing attacks.
The Broken Moon Light Wolf opened its mouth and ran towards Qin Hao's neck. It accelerated violently. The extremely fast speed made its figure blurred in Qin Hao's sight. Qin Hao felt the stench coming from in front of him. Then he thrust his hands forward, with his palms firmly against the chin of the Broken Moon Light Wolf. He kicked forward with his toes. With the blessing of killing intent, Qin Hao easily penetrated the defense of the Broken Moon Light Wolf.
puff!
